title: Cyberware vs bioware: telling the body-mod story visually
excerpt: Two families of body modification in sci-fi character art — metal and chrome versus organic and gene-edited. When to show, when to hide, where the body-horror line sits.
seo_title: Cyberware vs bioware in character art commissions
seo_description: Cyberware vs bioware in sci-fi character commissions — visible vs hidden mods, the body-horror line, and how to brief the story behind the modification.
